topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 66 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 8 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 12 common project-authored base contract(s) (chainlinkedoraclesimple, oraclesimple, auth). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
